contexts.text: The doctrine of faith ... is Divine truth from Divine good, and thus wholly Divine. What is Divine is incomprehensible, because above all understanding, even the angelic; but still this Divine, which in itself is incomprehensible, can inflow into the Rational of man through the Lord's Divine Human; and, when it inflows into his Rational, it is received there according to the truths which are there, thus variously...
